dedupe_keys.name: mise en place d un espace de developpement fluvial

description: Mise en place d’un espace de développement fluvial is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration de la gestion de l'eau. Preservation of an unexploited or extensively exploited river development area, of a width consistent with the river typology, ensuring a lateral connection with the alluvial plain, offering diverse aquatic and terrestrial habitats and allowing for a dynamic development of the river. Coverage: Administration de la gestion de l'eau. The portal shows the English title as "Establishment of a river development area" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration de la gestion de l'eau. Its keywords include morphologie, hymo, corridor, hydromorphologie, coursdeau, structure. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
